tails_note: lex.bg lines 45-46 print an additional-provision heading marked as new by DV br. 70/2026 (in force 01.01.2028) with no text under it, and line 48 renumbers the original § 1 as § 1a (marked 'Предишен § 1', so the lowest § reads as 2); the Gazette material 174310 (lines 244-431) is the original promulgation, with § 1 to § 8 matching lex.bg apart from marked amendments (§ 1a, § 3, § 5, § 6, § 6a), and it cannot hold the 2026 additional provision; the empty heading points to a provision of the amending act DV br. 70/2026, which neither text given here carries, and the whole text of this material would not carry it either
